title: A unified Foot and Mouth Disease dataset for Uganda: evaluating machine learning predictive performance degradation under varying distributions.
summary: a unified Uganda FMD dataset is used to measure model degradation under geographic/distribution shift; kNN drops 39.08% accuracy and 43.48% AUC across the reported shift, with different models/resampling showing substantial performance variability. This is an empirical, field-specific disease-surveillance data resource/result, not a universal model-performance claim. AI role: k-nearest neighbors and other machine-learning classifiers. The article appeared in Frontiers In Artificial Intelligence.
